outcomes.name: mandatory eligibility outranks an attractive but underqualified candidate
missing verification never awards a confirmed grade or confirmed-category points
required missing technology fails, optional missing technology remains eligible
employer clearing inferred language and tenure removes the hard conditions
required tenure uses actual supplied years, language uses ordinal minimum, missing values stay unknown
missing relocation is unknown, refusal is failure, consent is eligible
denial and learning do not become practical evidence or mandatory skills
affirmative clause next to denial is kept without transferring denied skills
repeating identical evidence does not increase relevance and irrelevant verbosity earns no extra points
score is explainable, finite, bounded, and uses provided evidence rather than external relevance labels
input ordering never changes tied ranking; rename IDs exposes arbitrary tie resolution
public projection and ranking explanations never reveal contact fields before consent
hidden FSP achievements and undisclosed contact identities cannot affect score or ranking
confirmed test result contributes monotonically without replacing minimum grade eligibility
self-declared specialization and high text fit never become a confirmed category
no FSP history leaves all other score components unchanged and does not exclude candidate
relevant FSP bonus cannot compensate an unmet mandatory grade
hidden real-looking FSP data is removed before ranking and cannot confer an achievement bonus
equal profiles rank a relevant FSP achievement above a less relevant discipline within the same category
category recommendations retain the exact requested category and count equal-profile variants

limitations: These controlled cases are authored by us, not independent recruiter labels or real hires.
No external dataset informs FSP/test/confirmed-grade expectations.
Counts measure functional invariants, not a numerical estimate of full-product matching accuracy.
Before strict verification, 19/20 cases passed: missing verified was incorrectly treated as confirmation. The explicit true contract closes that gap.

baseline.failingCase: missing verification never awards a confirmed grade or confirmed-category points
baseline.diagnosis: Raw missing verified was treated as confirmed; ordinary registration initializes false and catalogue visibility excludes missing verification.

contract.externalDatasetEffect: TalentMatch adapter supplies verified:false, so strict verification does not change its ranking inputs or frozen result.
